prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input: Image1 is the entire original Silent Storm opaque equipment diffuse atlas enlarged exactly8x nearest-neighbor solely to reveal source shape.
Request: Faithful HD material reconstruction; return the complete same square1:1 flat opaque UV atlas only.
Source inventory: Plain dark brown wooden mine-box UV atlas. Preserve original upper TWO-column by THREE-row timber grid, original separate broad horizontal wood strip below, and large lower-left wooden panel with its FOUR horizontal interior dividing bands and exactly ONE original round dark opening. Keep the same lower rectangular inset outlines/wood grain direction and pitch. Preserve lower-right TWO gray metallic UV fragments and the narrow dim green strip between them and the wood; retain the TWO faint pale source flecks along this green strip as faint flecks only, never hardware. No new nails, screw heads, holes, cracks, knots, planks or seams.

No crop, zoom, margins, rotation, repacking or bbox registration. Preserve all source materials and opaque black padding. Do not infer extra objects from texture fragments.

No curled, swirling, embossed, decorative, ornamental or repeating patterns, no ornamental strokes at any scale. Preserve exact original mark/detail counts, pitch, phase and silhouettes, including tiny glints. Do not add folds or surface marks. Original blank padding remains plain. Keep source muted palette/dark exposure, later brightness matched numerically.

No rendered item, perspective, scene or artistic redesign. Preserve exact source detail cadence, UV layout and material identity.
reference_recipe: Exact original entire canvas8x nearest sourceguide; no crop/padding/bbox/artistic edits. Raw entire-canvas normalized to logical4x Lanczos only, source alpha/numeric brightness handled by root.
